selectedProcedure.NEW_roster: At resolution fix every actual current enemy with positive-volume body intersection and an actual unobstructed center-to-body witness before any type/damage draws. Enemy is an actual recorded encounter opposition relation to this caster, not hidden alignment/faction standing or the player labeling a neutral target. Allies and caster are excluded unless they are genuinely enemies under an independently supplied relation; no generic family/party roster is revealed. NEW_random_table.scope: This is a declared spell-local elemental table using existing native damage types, not a universal definition of elemental. No Light/Dark/Chaos type, Prismatic Spray control table or damage-type scan is introduced.

selectedProcedure.NEW_resolution: For each fixed recipient draw its own type first and its own independent2d8 damage dice second. No shared damage roll, attack, save, selective exclusion after seeing a type, vulnerability reroll or player choice of element; none is printed, so automatic ordinary damage is explicitly selected. Resolve actual type-specific immunity/resistance/vulnerability, tempHP, HP, half-maximum Wound/death gates and concentration once under that root. Every root records original actual casting owner/source/rank/Null and selected current defenses. Same type on multiple bodies is possible and never merges those identities.
